# Third-party source

This directory contains source snapshots required to rebuild AdaptDrive runtime dependencies. Each dependency retains its upstream notices and has an AdaptDrive provenance record. Generated build directories, compiled objects, shared libraries, package metadata and Python caches are ignored and are not part of the canonical source snapshot.

`DCNv4/` is the complete Git-tracked OpenGVLab DCNv4 snapshot used by the four-level ego-conditioned feature adapter. See `DCNv4/ADAPTDRIVE_UPSTREAM.md` for its exact revision and `DCNv4/ADAPTDRIVE_BUILD.md` for the verified build/install boundary.
